title: Flat normalization stalks at the generic root divisor
statement: Let H be a commutative Noetherian ring, g an element with injective multiplication, H/(g) a domain, and n a positive integer. Put A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A and V=D(g). Assume each prime localization containing t is regular local and N is locally Noetherian. Let p:P -> V be finite etale and a=p composed with V -> N; assume its concrete relative normalization a.fromNormalization is finite. Let j:D -> N be an effective Cartier centre with D integral and image N minus V. For a generic point eta of D and every x in a.normalization with a.fromNormalization(x)=j(eta), the stalk map of a.fromNormalization at x is flat.

source.place: Tags 0EYG (height-one root-divisor calculation), 0307 (localization of integral closure), 0539 and 0AUW (torsion-free DVR modules are flat/free).

proof.text: Monicity of X^n-g gives A a finite free H-basis. Injective multiplication by g remains injective on A, and t^n=g gives injective multiplication by t. Evaluation at t=0 induces A/(t) = H/(g), so (t) is prime. The principal ideal theorem gives height at most one; the nonzerodivisor excludes height zero. Hence (t) has height one. These are the polynomial and prime-ideal calculations in 0EYG.

The equality t^n=g identifies the closed complement of V with V(t). The Cartier centre is a closed immersion. A generic point of its integral source maps to the generic point of its closed image. Thus j(eta) is (t). The regularity assumption at this prime makes A_(t) a one-dimensional regular local ring, hence a DVR.

Base change to the stalk at j(eta), using normalization-stalk-base-change with c the identity of N. Its punctured source is a finite etale algebra over the DVR fraction field. The affine relative normalization is the integral closure of the DVR in that algebra. It is a submodule of a vector space over the fraction field and thus torsion-free. Finiteness of a.fromNormalization makes this integral closure a finite module over the DVR. Apply finite torsion-free DVR modules are free. Its localizations at source primes remain flat, and canonical stalk identifications transport this flatness to every displayed stalk map.

lean.statement:
theorem root_normalization_generic_stalk_flat
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (g : H)
    (hg : IsSMulRegular H g) [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {g})]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    (∀ (Q : Ideal A) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
      letI := hQ
      AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C g) ∈ Q →
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)) →
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    ∀ (P : Scheme.{u}) (p : P ⟶ V.toScheme) (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∀ (x : a.normalization), a.fromNormalization x = j η →
        (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom.Flat
